cards.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
cards.description: Girls participate in horseback riding, swimming, canoeing, archery, land sports, arts and crafts, and outdoor activities. One-week starter, two-week, and traditional three-week options are offered.
cards.review_notes: Program information is undated; season year 2026 denotes fallback information, not a published dated schedule. The homepage states ages 5–16 but contains older historical wording. Starter sessions specifically serve first-time campers ages 5–10, rising kindergarten–5th grade; two-week sessions serve first-time campers or campers returning from Starter Session. No dated rows could be created.

cards.name: Leaders In Training
cards.description: Rising junior and senior girls combine traditional camp activities with leadership workshops, CPR/First Aid certification, supervised work with younger campers, and service projects. Session focuses include Ecuador Experience, Camp Deep-Dive, and Adventure Learning.
cards.review_notes: The LIT description and three session focuses are undated; no calendar dates or tuition were found. Season year 2026 denotes fallback information rather than a published dated schedule. Ecuador Experience begins and ends at camp and includes six days in Ecuador; it is retained as a focus within the local residential leadership program, not listed as a separate trip. The application and curriculum links could not be resolved from the readable supplied text. Accepted applicants' parents are instructed to complete registration through CampMinder.
